_meta.scope: shared; evaluate only against the active SKU sources

automatic_rejection_gates.condition: A concept scene or generative composite is presented as an actual photograph or final product proof without verification.
A supplied customer or mockup face is redrawn, beautified, aged, rotated, or varied when exact preservation is required.
The output adds, removes, duplicates, reorders, crops, or changes sticker positions against the locked asset-specific layout.
A locked logo, header, mock name, date, order field, footer, or QR is removed, rewritten, blurred, or regenerated incorrectly.
The actual photographed sheet becomes floating, plastic, overly thick, severely warped, or inconsistent with its real edge and shadow.
The image invents a universal count, unsupported material behavior, size, performance claim, packaging, or product feature.
A full-sheet gallery slot crops or hides the sheet boundary.
The result uses a yellow cast, candy-pastel scrapbook direction, clutter, or generic glossy CGI product styling.

score_categories.full_score: All source-locked product details match the registered references.
The gallery slot answers its assigned customer question immediately.
Sheet geometry, material response, perspective and shadow look photographed.
Product scale, crop and negative space suit the intended ecommerce slot.
The image feels warm, quiet, editorial, personal and restrained.
The image contributes a distinct role without duplicating another gallery slot.
Resolution, aspect ratio and crop room fit Shopify use.

score_interpretation.95_100: Eligible for final_candidate only if every automatic gate passes and a human verifies the sources.
score_interpretation.90_94: Strong review candidate. Revise one fidelity or visual issue.
score_interpretation.80_89: Direction may be useful but requires major correction.
